type.title: How will you provide services?
type.description: This decides how the calendar works and who does the work. You can change it later in settings.

individual.title: On your own
individual.body: You are the service. One calendar, your profile, your prices.

organization.title: A business with staff
organization.body: Several people under one name, with bookings in parallel.

title.individual: What should you be known as?

identity.description: This is the name customers see in search results and on your page.
identity.nameHint: You can change it later. Your page's address is generated from it.
identity.descriptionHint: Optional. A sentence or two about what you do and for whom.
identity.descriptionPlaceholder: Household plumbing across Maputo and Matola, travel included.

location.title: Where do you work?
location.description: We use this to show you to customers near you. Your exact address never appears on your public page.
location.streetHint: Optional. Leave it blank if you only work at the customer's.

payout.title: How would you like to be paid?
payout.description: This is where your earnings go after each job is completed. You can deal with it later.

BANK_ACCOUNT.title: Bank account
BANK_ACCOUNT.body: Transfer to your NIB or IBAN

review.title: {{name}} is under review
review.body: We will confirm who you are before showing you to customers. It usually takes a day or two, and we will email you.

meanwhile.services: Get your services and prices ready to publish
meanwhile.team: Invite your team, if you have one
